description: Get a pre-reasoned market briefing with trend signals and confidence scores, plus regime classification and a rule based note on what moved with the price in the briefings that carry them, for the requested domain (macro, rates, bonds, FX, commodities, a listed company, cross-asset or Bitcoin; the same families as the server instructions). Includes macro financial data, cross-asset correlations (equity indices, volatility, the dollar and Treasury yields, each beside Bitcoin) and crypto. Output is written to be read directly by reasoning agents, not parsed for individual values. Briefings are tier-gated: Free (btc.quick-check, btc.context, macro.snapshot, cross.correlations, btc.pulse, btc.grid-stress), Basic (btc.momentum, macro.liquidity, macro.auctions, btc.on-chain, cross.breadth, btc.miner-survival, btc.etf-flows, commodities.gold, commodities.silver, commodities.copper, commodities.wheat, eth.context, bonds.context, equities.company), Pro (cross.ai-compute, macro.rates, btc.full, btc.factors, cross.regime, fx.liquidity, btc.energy, btc.treasury, commodities.energy-basket, commodities.oil-producers, commodities.gold-miners, commodities.grains-agribusiness, bonds.full). Requires API key authentication.

block.description: One part of the company briefing, with entity (for example "valuation" or "against_guidance"); today only. Leave out for the whole briefing. A part counts one call; the whole briefing counts one for each part it carries.

date.description: Historical date in YYYY-MM-DD format (tier-gated: Free=30d; Basic=3y, Bitcoin briefings from Jan 2025; Pro=all)

entity.description: The company for a per company briefing: a US ticker or CIK (NVDA), a Japanese securities code (7203), a Korean stock code (005930) or an Indian company's ISIN (INE018A01030), with briefing=equities.company

format.description: Response format: markdown (human-readable, default) or json (structured data)

name: get_context
title: Get Market Briefing
